info.title: Mortgage Integration Agent — Partner API
info.description: Section 15.1 partner REST API. This artifact documents only the endpoints this codebase actually implements today (case creation, lookup, timeline, workflow-run start/status, and reviewer decisions; webhook endpoint registration and delivery lookup; tenant audit-event listing and a complete, self-describing-truncation export) — the full Section 15.1 surface (consents, documents, conditions, evidence, policy-snapshots, provider-operations) is not yet built and is not represented here.

bearer.description: A Section 20 M5 scoped API-client credential, "{clientId}.{secret}" — minted via `npm run create-api-client` (no self-service REST endpoint exists yet). The tenant is always the one this credential belongs to; no request body or query parameter can specify a different one.

cookie.name: meridian_session
cookie.description: Opaque HttpOnly human-session handle issued by the OIDC BFF. Unsafe requests also require the session CSRF value in X-CSRF-Token.

resolutionNote.description: Why the reviewer picked this outcome.

declaredCommandClass.description: Section 7.5's promotion-manifest validator checkpoint: what command class the underlying adapter declares, if any. Rejected outright if it names a structurally excluded class (FUNDS_MOVEMENT, RATE_LOCK, etc.) — nothing today has a real one to declare.

evidenceRef.description: A link or reference to the test evidence.

expectedCurrentManifestVersion.description: The manifestVersion this admin last saw active for this tuple (null if never activated) — an optimistic lock against two admins racing to activate two different manifests.

verificationReference.description: Non-sensitive operator or provider evidence reference proving backup expiry.

actualCostMinorUnits.description: Trusted actual provider cost in integer minor units; COMMITTED only.

reason.description: Only meaningful for REVOKE — the revocation reason.

targetUrl.description: Where signed delivery attempts are POSTed.

secret.description: HMAC signing secret. Store it now: future reads and mutations never return it.

targetUrl.description: Replacement HTTPS destination for future signed deliveries.

httpStatusCode.description: null on a network-level failure (timeout, connection refused) — no HTTP response was ever received.
